document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
On the deck, before your eyes a shadowy man changes into a 
mass of bubbling iridescent flesh, eyes, and mouths—a shoggoth! 
Make a Sanity roll and lose 1D6/1D20 Sanity points. 
Attempt a Dodge roll: succeed and you get away, go to 
wherever you started the voyage—either 500 or to 501. Fail the 
roll and you are engulfed by the shoggoth and devoured entirely. 
It is ... THE END.
(462)
